title: MSHvSF Saturn semantic model
model_kind: Evidence-backed external behavioral model; internal SH-2 state is not yet traced

runtime.route: Two-player Ryu/Ken vs Spider-Man/Captain America; P2 remains neutral after setup

route.control: Native replay applies exact Port 1 and Port 2 bytes; P2 is neutral after setup

subsystems.proven: The fixed backup plus replay deterministically traverses title, Versus selection, teams, mode, speed, stage, and gameplay.
subsystems.missing: SH-2 state addresses, mode/round structures, and writer functions.

subsystems.proven: Standard-pad active-low bytes and exact frame edges are reproduced for both controller ports.
subsystems.missing: SMPC read routine, game input buffer, command parser, and latency to actor state.

subsystems.proven: Ryu responds to walk, jump, and normal inputs and Spider-Man remains neutral until the hit reaction.
subsystems.missing: Actor bases, struct stride, coordinates, velocity, state, animation, collision, and health fields.

subsystems.proven: Idle, walk, jump, normal, hit reaction, and recovery anchors reproduce byte-identically across two cold runs.
subsystems.missing: Animation tables, rendered-frame durations, normalized trajectories, and SH-2 state transitions.

subsystems.proven: The normal visibly contacts Spider-Man, triggers FIRST ATTACK, changes the health HUD, and produces a hit reaction while P2 is neutral.
subsystems.missing: Hitbox records, collision routine, health field, exact damage, hitstop, and reaction-state data. Hadouken is deferred.

subsystems.proven: The route produces stable foreground, background, effects, and HUD output.
subsystems.missing: VDP1 command tables, VDP2 registers/layers, VRAM addresses, palette ownership, and transfer path.

subsystems.proven: The disc contains ADP members and eleven CD audio tracks; the runtime emits audio.
subsystems.missing: Normal-hit event routing, SCSP slots/RAM, ADP decoder, CDDA selection, and onset timing.

subsystems.proven: The flat ISO contains 414 files in eight measured naming families.
subsystems.missing: Package format, decompressed size, load destination, lifetime, eviction, DMA, and CD seek schedule.
